# Rachel's List Guides

> Real wedding prices, each one checked on the official or seller's own page and dated. Courthouse fees, small and micro wedding venues, elopement packages and secondhand designer wedding dresses in Houston, Chicago, New York, Dallas and Los Angeles. Free calculators: wedding alcohol calculator. No affiliate links. Built by Rachel's List (https://rachelslist.co).
